_notes: Copy to cameras.json in the folder you start the tracker from (next to arena.json); it is then loaded automatically.
Each entry is one EXTRA camera; the main camera is still chosen in the GUI. See multi_camera.py for every item.
camera: index or part of the device name. calib: chessboard .npz (strongly recommended for the GO 3S wide lens).
Without calib or focal_px the camera fits its lens to the 4 pivots once and prints focal_px / k1 to paste here.
max_fps: how often this camera is processed; tag detection is CPU-bound and shares the CPU with the main camera.
